items.html:
Introduction

Paradisefold, founded in 2021 by creator Andrea Malouf, is a fashion and lifestyle brand that provides beautiful solutions to aesthetic and emotional needs, such as beauty, hair maintenance, rest, and confident self-expression. With a background in international development, Andrea spent years working in South East Asia, the Middle East and Europe, before transitioning into fashion design. Paradisefold was searching for a replacement for their existing loyalty and rewards setup. As a British, Arab, Black-owned brand, Paradisefold is carbon positive and aims to live values committed to diversity, ethical fashion, and global influence.

Born out of a personal need after an extended hospital stay, Andrea created Paradisefold to blend functionality with aesthetics and quality materials.

“I was looking for a different kind of hair wrap, a silk one, and I couldn’t find one that I really thought would make me feel like I wasn’t feeling very frumpy.” Andrea Malouf
Founder of Paradisefold

Andrea’s curly hair had been damaged due to various factors, and she wanted a product that would both protect her hair and reflect her personality.

“I couldn’t find what I liked. I thought I could design something that I would like, something that my friends would like. And then it just kind of started, just grew from there.” Andrea Malouf
Founder of Paradisefold

As Paradisefold grew (5,000% from its first year), Andrea recognized the need for a loyalty and rewards program that would support the brand’s customer engagement and retention while remaining cost-effective. Finding the right platform that offered a seamless and integrated experience without high costs posed a significant challenge.

The Challenge

growing eCommerce store, they required:

  • An Integrated Platform: A solution that seamlessly combined reviews, rewards, and VIP programs
  • Flexibility: A customizable tool that could grow with their needs without excessive costs for minor changes.
  • Reliability and Support: A hands-on team that listens to feedback and delivers on promises.

Finding a platform that met these criteria while staying affordable was a major hurdle for the brand.

The Solution: Appstle Loyalty & Rewards

During their search, Paradisefold discovered, Appstle Loyalty & Reward, in early 2023, while Appstle Loyalty was still in its Minimum Viable Product (MVP) stage. Despite being in early development, the app showed significant promise to meet Paradisefold’s needs. Recognizing its potential, Paradisefold partnered with the Appstle team. Paradisefold gave feedback and helped proactively shape Appstle’s development in a way that works well for young, fast-growing brands.

Key Features of Appstle Loyalty that Made a Difference

  • Seamless Integration: The Appstle Loyalty app unified rewards, reviews, and VIP programs into a single, comprehensive software solution.
  • Customizable Features: Paradisefold gained access to adaptable tools, allowing the brand to tailor the platform to its specific needs.
  • Exceptional Customer Support: The Appstle team provided outstanding service, actively listening to feedback and making improvements accordingly. A recent interaction with team members further reinforced Paradisefold’s confidence in Appstle’s commitment to customer satisfaction.

The Results

Through this collaboration, Paradisefold achieved remarkable improvements in its loyalty program:

  • Enhanced Loyalty Program Efficiency: Simplified management of rewards and VIP strategies, leading to improved customer engagement, at a more realistic cost for an SME.
  • Sustainable Growth: The continuous development and feature additions in Appstle Loyalty enabled Paradisefold to scale its loyalty efforts without the burden of excessive costs or complexity.
  • Confidence in Support: Paradisefold praised Appstle’s responsiveness and ability to deliver on promises, fostering trust and long-term satisfaction.

Andrea Malouf shared her experience working with Appstle:

“I love this app. A couple of years ago, I was searching high and low for a Loyalty and Rewards app to replace my existing solution. My store is medium-sized, and I wanted something integrated across reviews, rewards, and VIP.
At the time, Appstle Loyalty app had just been released as an MVP and was still being developed. I spoke to the team and shared my requirements—they grew the functionality exactly as promised. They really listen to merchant feedback. To this day, their customer service remains excellent! So pleased I found them, and I very much recommend them!”

Conclusion

Paradisefold’s journey with Appstle Loyalty & Rewards showcases the power of collaboration and innovation in creating a successful loyalty program. By trusting Appstle, Paradisefold not only overcame its initial challenges but also built a foundation for long-term growth and customer engagement.

items.html:
How Birch Boys Found its Roots in Chaga

Birch Boys, a company specializing in sustainably sourced Chaga products, began its e-commerce journey in 2016 with Shopify. Founded by Garrett Kopp, the business has a unique origin story rooted in the Adirondack Park region of New York. Garrett’s grandmother introduced him to Chaga, a medicinal fungus, during her battle with pancreatic cancer. This discovery ultimately led to the creation of Birch Boys, which has since grown into a highly successful, vertically integrated business, offering a range of Chaga-based products, including teas, tinctures, and skincare.

The Roadblocks to Subscription Success

Challenge

Before implementing Appstle Subscriptions, Birch Boys faced significant challenges with their previous subscription platform – a competition subscription app, also on Shopify. Key issues for them included:

  • A cumbersome customer interface that was difficult for users to navigate.
  • Inability to support mixed carts (subscription and non-subscription items), leading to customer frustration.
  • High costs and inefficiencies in managing customer subscriptions, which consumed valuable time and resources.
“With our previous subscriptions software, I essentially knew every customer by name because they had so many issues!! We needed a solution that was more intuitive and customer-friendly.” Kaitlin Lawless
Vice President of Birch Boys

Finding the Right Fit: Appstle Subscriptions

Solution

After evaluating several options, Birch Boys chose Appstle Subscriptions due to its:

  • Highly customizable customer portal, tailored to simplify the subscription experience for their older demographic.
  • Ability to support mixed carts, resolving previous customer pain points.
  • Cost-effectiveness, saving Birch Boys approximately $700 annually compared to their previous platform.
  • Responsive and helpful support team, which played a critical role in addressing implementation challenges.
“Appstle’s customization options are phenomenal. We were able to tailor the platform to meet the specific needs of our older demographic, making it incredibly user-friendly.” Kaitlin Lawless
Vice President of Birch Boys

Navigating the Transition to Appstle

Implementation Process

The transition to Appstle Subscriptions was a smooth and collaborative process, showcasing Appstle’s commitment to customer success. From the beginning of the migration, the Appstle team provided exceptional support, ensuring Birch Boys could quickly and efficiently migrate from their previous platform.

“Appstle’s support team was super responsive. Whenever we had questions or needed assistance, they were there to help us immediately.” Kaitlin Lawless
Vice President of Birch Boys

The migration process was straightforward, with Birch Boys exporting their data from their old Subscriptions app, and seamlessly integrating it into Appstle. Kaitlin noted,

“We exported our data from the previous subscriptions app provider, and with just a few manual adjustments, it synced perfectly with Appstle. The process was straightforward, and the Appstle team guided us every step of the way.” Kaitlin Lawless
Vice President of Birch Boys

The Appstle team’s expertise and hands-on approach were instrumental in ensuring a successful implementation. Kaitlin highlighted,

“The Appstle team was fantastic. They quickly understood our needs and helped us get everything set up efficiently. The whole team was incredibly supportive.” Kaitlin Lawless
Vice President of Birch Boys

This seamless transition allowed Birch Boys to focus on delivering a better experience for their customers without disruption. The positive implementation experience reinforced Birch Boys’ confidence in Appstle as a reliable partner.

Measurable Improvements with Appstle

Enhanced Customer Experience

Since adopting Appstle Subscriptions, Birch Boys has experienced significant improvements in both customer satisfaction and internal operations.

Customers now enjoy the ease of subscription management through features like magic links and a user-friendly portal. Kaitlin explained,

“Since switching to Appstle, we’ve seen a significant reduction in customer complaints related to subscriptions. Our customers love the ease of use and the magic links feature.” Kaitlin Lawless
Vice President of Birch Boys

The ability to support mixed carts has also been a great benefit for Birch Boys.

“Appstle allowed a mixed cart of items, some items bought under ‘subscribe and save’ and some bought as one-time purchases. This prevented customers from having to place two separate orders with separate shipping costs, which they really appreciated.” Kaitlin Lawless
Vice President of Birch Boys

Improved Operational Efficiency

The Vice President of Birch Boys noted a substantial increase in productivity, as less time is spent on customer service duties related to subscription management.

“Appstle allowed a mixed cart of items, some items bought under ‘subscribe and save’ and some bought as one-time purchases. This prevented customers from having to place two separate orders with separate shipping costs, which they really appreciated.” Kaitlin Lawless
Vice President of Birch Boys

Business Growth and Retention

The subscription program has become a valuable tool for customer retention, offering convenience and ease of use. Birch Boys now has a growing number of subscribers who require minimal intervention, a stark contrast to the frequent issues experienced with their past subscription software.

“Our subscription program is about customer ease and retention and Appstle has made a huge difference in the ease of use for our customers.” Kaitlin Lawless
Vice President of Birch Boys

Educating Customers on Chaga

In addition to improving their subscription model, Birch Boys is committed to educating their customers about Chaga.

They have created a blog titled 10 Misconceptions About Chaga to dispel common myths and provide accurate information about this unique fungus. Kaitlin emphasized, “

“We’re the Chaga authority, especially in North America. Our blog helps customers understand what Chaga is, how it’s sourced, and its benefits.” Kaitlin Lawless
Vice President of Birch Boys

You can read more about Chaga and its unique properties in their blog here: 10 Misconceptions About Chaga.

A Partnership That Delivered Results

Conclusion

Appstle Subscriptions has proven to be a valuable partner for Birch Boys, enabling them to deliver a superior customer experience while streamlining internal operations. The platform’s flexibility, cost-effectiveness, and robust support have made it a perfect fit for Birch Boys’ unique needs. As a result, Birch Boys has not only improved customer satisfaction but also enhanced its overall business efficiency.

Birch Boys highly recommends Appstle Subscriptions to other businesses in their industry.

“Appstle has allowed us to offer a subscription model that’s ethical and customer-focused. We’re not about trapping customers in subscriptions—we want to make it easy for them to manage their orders.” Kaitlin Lawless
Vice President of Birch Boys

With its customizable features, competitive pricing, and exceptional support, Appstle Subscriptions App is an ideal solution for companies looking to optimize their subscription models while prioritizing customer satisfaction.

items.html:
Rosemira is a growing skincare business based in the US, specializing in providing high-quality, clean beauty products. As their business expanded, they needed a robust and reliable subscription management system that would streamline operations, provide flexibility for their customers, and offer strong customer support.
Rosemira decided to integrate Appstle Subscriptions into their e-commerce platform and has seen significant improvements in how they manage their subscription-based model.

Overcoming Operational Inefficiencies and Subscription Management Struggles

Prior to implementing Appstle Subscriptions, Rosemira used a variety of subscription tools and apps to handle their subscription model needs, but this created complexity and inefficiency in their operations. They encountered multiple challenges with managing customer subscriptions, providing flexibility, and handling customer service inquiries effectively.

“Before (we switched to) Appstle, we were using several tools and apps, but they just weren’t integrated well. We were facing problems with managing subscriptions, and customers didn’t have the flexibility they needed. We were also struggling with customer service. There were too many gaps and disjointed processes.”

Why Rosemira Chose Appstle Subscriptions for Seamless Integration and Support

Rosemira chose Appstle Subscriptions for its seamless integration with their Shopify built store, ease of setup, and comprehensive features designed for subscription-based businesses. Appstle’s 24x7x365 merchant service stood out to Rosemira, as it offered fast and accessible support whenever needed.

“Appstle Subscriptions stood out to us because it integrated seamlessly with Shopify, was super easy to set up, and had all the features we needed for our subscription-based business. The customer service is really important to us, and Appstle has been incredibly fast and accessible whenever we needed help.”

Effortless Setup and Immediate Support: The Appstle Experience

Setting up Appstle Subscriptions was a smooth and seamless process. According to Rosemira, “Setting it up was easy, and the customer support is really available… they’re available immediately, not like, ‘Okay, we’ll contact you on Monday because we’re closed for the weekend.’” The quick response times and helpful customer service were critical for Rosemira’s business, as they needed a subscription system that worked smoothly from day one, and quick, targeted help when they had technical questions.

Key Features and Benefits:

1. Flexibility and Control:
One of the standout features of Appstle Subscriptions for Rosemira is the flexibility it offers to both the business and their customers. Rosemira appreciates that Appstle Subscriptions’ system allows customers to easily modify or cancel their subscriptions if necessary.

“I think one of the things that’s important is that our customers allowed to cancel things and modify the subscriptions’ quantity, variant, etc. And, it is important for me to be able to stop an order from shipping for whatever reasons. I didn’t want a subscription tool that is rigid and does not allow me or my customers the flexibility. These kinds of little things are important for my customers and our business.
The level of flexibility Appstle Subscriptions provides its merchants and their customers ensures that everyone has a customers have a positive experience and a smooth journey”

2. Customer Support:
Rosemira values the customer service they receive from Appstle, which they consider to be one of the most important aspects of their experience.

“To me, customer service is one of the most important things in any service… If you’re a software provider, make brilliant software, but dont guide or help people utilize it, then how brilliant is it?”

Rosemira has been impressed with the responsiveness and effectiveness of the Appstle team. They have also benefited from features such real-time and customized Loom videos to help with setup and troubleshooting.

3. Seamless Integration:
Before switching to Appstle, Rosemira was frustrated by the fragmented systems they had to manage. “It all has to kind of go together… to just have one system that does everything, instead of multiple systems that you have to kind of piece and string together.” Appstle helped solve this problem by providing a unified platform for managing subscriptions, notifications, and payments—all within one system.

4. Customer-Centric Features:
The Appstle platform also offers customer-friendly features such as the ability to pause and skip orders before they are shipped. Appstle also enables customers and merchants and swap the products in a subscription, and add one time product purchases to an upcoming delivery.
Rosemira highlights, “You provide the notifications for people in real-time and in pre-set intervals so they don’t have to get the order if they don’t want to. You can stop the shipment.” These simple but significantly impactful features improve the customer experience and reduce customer service inquiries related to unwanted shipments.

5. Scalability and Cost-Effectiveness:
Rosemira appreciates the scalability of Appstle Subscriptions. As a growing business, Rosemira requires a platform that will enable and support their growth. They also find the pricing to be competitive, making it a cost-effective solution for their needs. The ease of use, scale, and affordability of the system has contributed to their continued satisfaction with the platform.

Streamlined Processes and Reduced Churn: The Impact of Appstle Subscriptions on Rosemira’s Business

Since implementing Appstle Subscriptions, Rosemira has experienced significant improvements in managing their subscriptions business model. The flexibility of the Appstle Subscriptions platform has provided a seamless and straightforward way for their customers to manage their subscriptions and recurring orders. Additionally, the highly streamlined processes with Appstle Subscriptions, saved time for Rosemira’s team, allowing them to focus on other aspects of their business such as creating new product formulas and focusing on growth.

Conclusion:

Rosemira’s results with Appstle Subscriptions has been stellar, with the platform offering a flexible and user-friendly solution that has significantly improved their subscription management, sales, and revenue. The integration of Appstle Subscriptions with their Shopify store was seamless, and the ease of setup allowed them to get started with the software quickly, with no downtime. As Rosemira’s founder pointed out,

“The setup was so easy, it really saved us time and effort—something we greatly appreciated as a growing business.”

The ability to manage subscriptions with powerful automations and minimal manual work has been a major benefit, streamlining operations and allowing Rosemira to dedicate more time to other aspects of the business. The flexibility that Appstle offers has also been crucial in reducing churn by providing customers with control over their subscriptions. “I like that my customers can pause or change their subscriptions without going through a lot of hoops,” said Rosemira’s founder. This flexibility has enhanced customer satisfaction, as it aligns with Rosemira’s commitment to providing a highly personalized, customer-first experience.

Moreover, Rosemira has been impressed with Appstle’s exceptional customer support which is available 24x7x365, which has proven to be one of the standout features of the platform. “Customer service is one of the most important things to us, and Appstle’s team has been responsive and helpful every step of the way,” said Rosemira’s founder. With the support of Appstle’s merchant success team, including the use of customized tutorial videos, Rosemira has felt well-equipped to fully utilize the Appstle’s comprehensive features.

In summary, Rosemira has found in Appstle Subscriptions, the ideal software tool to simplify their subscription process, reduce manual work, and offer their customers the flexibility they need. The combination of ease of use, robust support, and customer-centered flexibility has solidified Rosemira’s confidence in Appstle as a long-term software partner for scaling their business.

“I recommend Appstle because of the ease of setup, excellent customer support, and the flexibility it provides for my customers. As a growing business, it’s exactly what we needed to simplify and scale our subscription process.”

items.title: AIC Expat – Expanding Relocation Services with Appstle’s Memberships App

seo.title: AIC Expat’s Growth Through Membership Services | Appstle
seo.description: Amsterdam International Community (AIC) Expat, founded and run by globally curious enthusiasts, is a key resource for expatriates in Amsterdam.

items.html:
Navigating New Paths with Appstle Memberships: AIC Expat’s Journey to Continuous Client Value

Amsterdam International Community (AIC) Expat, founded and run by globally curious enthusiasts, is a key resource for expatriates in Amsterdam. AIC Expat offers memberships through the AIC card, which grants members free or discounted access to events, as well as exclusive deals with partners. These partnerships include service-based companies such as lawyers, rental agencies, and local businesses that serve and benefit expats. Through a membership-based model, powered by Appstle Memberships, AIC connects Amsterdam’s expats with resources and with each other, fostering a welcoming community in the city.

“We organize events for expats in Amsterdam…When they purchase the card, we give them tickets for events or discounts on other events, such as yoga sessions, theater performances, and other social events.”

As the expat community in Amsterdam grew, so did the founder’s mission to help newcomers settle in the city. This led the team to explore a recurring membership model using Appstle’s Memberships app, aiming to streamline operations and offer consistent, reliable support for expats.

“The founder, Attila, is Italian but lives in the Netherlands…he started AIC Expats as a hobby because he enjoys meeting new people. Over time, he realized that many people were interested in what he was offering, so it became more than just a hobby.”

The Roadblocks to Growth:

Overcoming Key Challenges

While AIC Expat found success in organizing events and offering membership perks, they faced several challenges in scaling and retaining members over time:

  1. Engaging Long-term Residents: The organization found that members who had lived in Amsterdam for a while were less likely to renew their memberships. AIC Expat wanted to ensure they provided enough value to retain members longer, as some members would naturally discontinue once they felt fully settled.
“People who have lived in the Netherlands for a while are no longer considered expats…They may decide to discontinue their membership if they no longer found value in it, or they may move elsewhere.”
  1. Managing Membership Options with Variants: Organizing tickets with multiple options, such as early-bird or student rates, occasionally created confusion in the app interface.
“It works well for most products, but when we have variants…for example, with a comedy show, we offer regular tickets, early-bird tickets, student tickets, and tickets for AIC card members. The AIC card ticket is the one I want to hide, but our previous software did not automatically adjust when there are variants.”
  1. Using Data to Enhance Event Offerings: AIC wanted to better understand which events were most popular, and when membership sign-ups peaked, to make data-driven decisions that would improve retention.
“We wanted to use the analytics feature to track how long people keep their memberships…wine-tasting events seem to draw more people, and people tend to sign up for the AIC card to get the discount for those events. We wanted data to support or challenge our observations.”

AIC Expat Adopts Appstle’s Subscription Model

The Game-Changing Solution:

To address these challenges, AIC Expat integrated Appstle’s Shopify and Shopify Plus focused Memberships App into their existing Shopify store. This solution provided the infrastructure for a recurring membership model with three-month and six-month packages, keeping AIC Expat’s members engaged with frequent events and service discounts.

Crafting a Tailored Membership Experience: AIC Expat developed multiple membership tiers that catered to different expat segments and their varying needs. Now, with the AIC card, members can access recurring events and enjoy discounts on unique experiences in Amsterdam.

Smooth Integration and Streamlined Operations: Appstle’s Shopify Memberships app enabled seamless integration with AIC’s existing Shopify setup. It allowed the team to manage recurring member payments, adjust membership plans, and customize membership perks, all in one place.

“It works well for most products, but when we have variants…for example, with a comedy show, we offer regular tickets, early-bird tickets, student tickets, and tickets for AIC card members. The AIC card ticket is the one I want to hide, but our previous software did not automatically adjust when there are variants.”

Enhanced Customer Retention with Engagement and Flexibility: Automated billing cycles and easy membership and member management that are pillars of Appstle Memberships improved member retention of AIC Epat. AIC Expat could also quickly respond to feedback, helping them refine event offerings and keep members satisfied.

“When I reached out to Appstle’s customer service about a settings question, they were very fast and helpful. They explained everything hands-on and comprehensively, and I understood the solution right away.”

Utilizing Analytics for Data-Driven Decisions: The app’s analytics tools allowed AIC Expats to track member trends, event popularity, and the months with the highest retention rates. This insight enabled the team to make more strategic decisions, focusing on popular events and timing offers to coincide with peak periods.

“Using the Appstle Membership app’s granular analytics has helped us understand which events are most popular. This Allows us to plan better for the future…for example, we learned that when we offer food and drink-related events, we tend to see an increase in membership sign-ups.”

AIC Expat’s Success Story

Transformational Outcomes:

With the support of Appstle’s Shopify Memberships app, AIC Expat achieved significant improvements in both member retention and operational efficiency:

  1. Consistent Recurring Revenue: By shifting to a subscription-based membership, AIC Expat now enjoys predictable income, helping them better plan for future growth.
“In addition to generating revenue we’re happy that we’re able to help people connect through a community.”
  1. Higher Member Retention: The new membership model encouraged members to renew, resulting in longer-lasting relationships and increased engagement.
“Using the app’s analytics has helped us understand which events are most popular, which allows us to plan better for future events.”
  1. Enhanced Operational Efficiency: The streamlined membership and billing process saved time and allowed the team to focus on creating more value for members.
“Overall, the Appstle software is easy to understand and use. When I joined the company two years ago, the system was already set up by Attila. I quickly got the hang of it, and I think it’s very intuitive.”
  1. Increased Customer Satisfaction: With personalized event offerings and easy subscription management, AIC Expat successfully improved their member experience.
“The app has helped us better serve our members and keep them feel valued and satisfied. We can focus more on creating events they’ll love.”

AIC Expat’s Path Forward with Appstle

Charting the Future:

The integration of Appstle’s Shopify Memberships app transformed AIC Expat’s approach to membership management, enabling them to retain members for longer periods while consistently meeting their needs. The insights gained from the app’s analytics allow the team to make informed decisions about event planning and membership offerings, ultimately contributing to a stronger and more connected community in Amsterdam.

seo.description: True Moringa is a pioneer in the skincare and wellness industry, harnessing the power of the moringa tree to create superfood-powered products.

items.html:
Transforming Lives with Nature’s Superfood

True Moringa is a pioneer in the skincare and wellness industry, harnessing the power of the moringa tree to create superfood-powered products. Founded by Harvard graduate Emily Cunningham and MIT graduate Kwami Williams, True Moringa was inspired by Kwami’s return to his home country – Ghana – where he met farmers living on less than $2 per day despite having access to high-value botanicals in their own backyards – including moringa – known locally as “the miracle tree”. He listened and learned from farmers, scientists, and herbalists who taught him about the incredible benefits of the moringa tree for health, for skincare, and for the climate.

This led to the creation of a company that not only produces high-quality skincare and wellness products but also works to improve the livelihoods of over 5000 small farmers in Ghana. Every order placed through their website plants a tree in your name. To date, True Moringa has planted over 3 million trees to combat malnutrition and deforestation.

Switching to Appstle Subscriptions: A Strategic Move

In 2016, True Moringa transitioned from Squarespace to Shopify to take advantage of the platform’s robust e-commerce functionality. As their business grew, they recognized the need to build a community of loyal customers who would repeatedly purchase their products. True Moringa experimented with several subscription apps on Shopify but faced various challenges until a friend recommended Appstle Subscriptions!

The transition to Appstle Subscriptions in 2023 proved to be a game-changer for the company.

A Smooth Migration and Integration

The migration from their previous subscription app to Appstle was facilitated by Appstle’s dedicated migrations team which is available 24x7x365, ensuring a seamless transition. True Moringa appreciated the ease of integrating Appstle with their inventory system, avoiding the need to create multiple SKUs for the same product, which had previously caused confusion in inventory management.

Enhancing Customer Experience and Loyalty

One of the standout features of Appstle for True Moringa was Appstle’s Build-a-Box functionality, which allows customers to bundle or custom-build/select three items and create their own customized subscription box at a discounted rate. This feature has been instrumental in increasing customer satisfaction and total order value for True Moringa.
Additionally, the integration of Appstle Subscriptions with Klaviyo, True Moringa’s email marketing platform, has enabled them to effectively reach out to and engage with their subscribers in a personalized manner.

“The Build-a-Box feature has been incredibly helpful in giving our customers the flexibility to choose the products they love. The seamless integration with Klaviyo has also been crucial in maintaining strong communication with our subscribers.” Emily Cunningham
Co-founder of True Moringa

Data-Driven Decisions and Customer Insights

Appstle’s subscription platform has provided True Moringa with valuable insights into customer behavior. By analyzing their recurring orders, deliveries, and subscribers’ data, True Moringa has been able to make highly informed and scalable decisions about product usage and marketing strategies.

Dummy data

For example, they discovered that customers who ordered their multitasking oil on a monthly basis were likely using it daily, which led them to highlight the oil’s various day-to-day uses in their marketing efforts to encourage more frequent orders.

Increasing Revenue and Customer Lifetime Value

“Having loyal subscribers reduces our need for expensive remarketing campaigns. It helps increase customer lifetime value and keeps our customers happy.” Emily Cunningham
Co-founder of True Moringa

Overcoming Past Software Challenges with Appstle’s Hands-on Support

True Moringa faced several issues with their previous subscription apps, including buggy software and poor customer service.

Appstle’s responsive support team and the platform’s robust features resolved these challenges, allowing True Moringa to focus on growing their business.

“The migration process was very smooth, and the Appstle team was extremely responsive. Their customer service is top-notch and highly reliable, which is crucial for a growing business such as ours.” Emily Cunningham
Co-founder of True Moringa

Maintaining a Competitive Edge in a Growing Market

In an industry with numerous wellness brands, True Moringa has been able to maintain its competitive edge by leveraging Appstle’s features. The software’s ability to turn one-time customers into loyal subscribers has been particularly valuable, especially in the wake of iOS changes that have made customer acquisition more challenging.

Recommendations and Future Growth

True Moringa unequivocally recommends Appstle Subscriptions to other Shopify and Shopify Plus brands.

“We recommend Appstle for its compelling and robust functionalities, excellent customer service, and the powerful Build-a-Box feature. It has streamlined our inventory management and also integrates seamlessly with Klaviyo.” Emily Cunningham
Co-founder of True Moringa

Looking ahead, True Moringa plans to continue leveraging Appstle’s features to scale their operations and expand their market reach. The company’s commitment to using superfood-powered ingredients and sustainable farming practices positions them well for sustained growth in the skincare and wellness industry.

True Moringa’s journey with Appstle underscores the platform’s effectiveness in addressing the unique challenges of subscription-based businesses. Their ongoing success and expansion reflect their confidence in Appstle’s ability to support their growth trajectory. True Moringa’s experience stands as a testament to the transformative power of Appstle Subscriptions in driving business success.

seo.title: From Pet Passion to Retail Success with Appstle Subscriptions App - Appstle
seo.description: Discover how HayPigs turned pet passion into retail success with Appstle's innovative solutions.

items.html:
HayPigs!®, a UK-based animal specialist store, specializes in providing toys, food, accessories, and more, for guinea pigs and other small pets! Founded by a product designer turned entrepreneur, Rik Cridland, and wife, Helen Cridland, after rescuing a couple of guinea pigs from a local rescue shelter, HayPigs!® has grown steadily over its eight-year journey. Initially starting with designing toys for guinea pigs under the HayPigs!® brand, the business significantly expanded to carrying over 15 brands to become a one-stop shop for small animal supplies.
Let’s see how HayPigs!® used Appstle Subscriptions to grow its subscription business model and build a loyal subscriber base.

Navigating Growth: Overcoming E-commerce Challenges and Implementing a Subscription Model

As HayPigs!® expanded, they encountered limitations with their previous e-commerce platform, prompting a need for a more adaptable solution – Shopify!

“HayPigs!® wasn’t initially on Shopify, but we hit a buffer with the provider we had in terms of how far we could take it (the business). We needed to move to something more adaptable, something that could deal with the vast inventory we had. So moving to the Shopify ecosystem was a great solution!
What I love about Shopify is the fact that we can do all the work on it. We don’t need to employ a development team to make changes and try things.”

Additionally, they sought to implement a subscription model to build their recurring revenue stream and enhance their customer retention. However, past experiences with subscription models for their sister business – Guinea Pig Magazine (with other subscription software), had tough learnings, leading to concerns about finding the right subscription solution for HayPigs!®.

“Despite having faced some difficult challenges implementing a subscription model with our other business (Guinea Pig Magazine) we always fancied starting one (a subscription model) with HayPigs!®. With a growing portfolio of edible treats and playthings, a subscription box for small pet enthusiasts was a perfect fit for us, and we could see there was a market for it. Besides, we knew subscriptions would be an excellent strategy to increase our customer retention and CLTV.”

Soon, HayPigs!® transitioned to Shopify, seeking a platform that could accommodate their growing inventory and offer flexibility for future development. To implement their subscription model seamlessly, they turned to Appstle, a top app offering subscription management solutions for Shopify and Shopify Plus stores.

Why Appstle Subscriptions?

“We were obviously a little bit hands-on about making the right choice for HayPigs!® knowing the commitment we’d be making. When I think back, it was Appstle’s speedy responsiveness, and merchant-first mentality that made us choose them.
When I initially approached Appstle, We had lots of questions “Can Appstle do this? Is it possible to achieve these objectives? Can we adapt this (feature) to suit our goals, work for our customers, fit with our brand, etc? We were very impressed by Appstle’s comprehensive answers and adaptability to our needs.”

Moreover, Appstle’s user-friendly interface and responsive customer service stood out, providing HayPigs!® with the confidence to navigate their subscription model effectively, recalls Rik Cridland

“We explored other subscription solutions on Shopify too, but there were limitations with all of them. And that’s where we plumped for Appstle as it really met our needs at a price point that was sensible and could grow with us.”

Customization

“We had a lot of requests early on to adapt and customize Appstle to our store. We needed to adapt the widgets to look more in keeping with our website, we needed to change the color, the messaging, and other things like that, to fine tune the overall fit with the rest of our customer journey. Whatever we wanted, we were able to talk to somebody very quickly and get it done.
On the rare occasion that we did have an issue, like a glitch, which happens with all software, the speed at which a technical experts would take a look and fix it for us has been tremendous. And that’s one of the main reasons it’s been so successful for us.”

Streamlining Subscription Management with Appstle Subscriptions

Appstle’s Subscriptions App offered HayPigs!® the features they needed to launch and manage their subscription offerings. With Appstle Subscriptions, HayPigs!® could customize subscription plans, offer flexible delivery frequencies, and automate renewal processes. The seamless integration of Appstle with their fulfillment warehouse streamlined order processing, ensuring a smooth customer experience.

Driving Success: Key Outcomes of HayPigs!®’ Subscription Management with Appstle

By leveraging Appstle’s subscription management capabilities, HayPigs!® achieved several key outcomes:

Conclusion

With Appstle’s support, HayPigs!® successfully implemented a powerful subscription model, unlocking new revenue streams and improving customer satisfaction. By choosing a platform that aligns with their business goals and values, HayPigs!® has set the stage for sustainable growth and continued success in the competitive pet industry.

items.title: Two Dudes Uncomplicates Men’s Grooming with Appstle Subscriptions

seo.title: Two Dudes Uncomplicates Men's Grooming with Appstle Subscriptions - Appstle
seo.description: Learn how Two Dudes simplified men's grooming with Appstle's subscription solutions.

items.html:
A New Era in Men’s Grooming

Two Dudes is a New Zealand-based company specializing in men’s natural grooming products. Founded by university friends Michael McRae and Tomas Tappin who saw a gap in the market for straightforward, high-quality skincare tailored to men, the company aimed to provide products that evolved with men’s changing needs, preferences, and lifestyle.
Before adopting Appstle, Two Dudes faced challenges in scaling their subscription model and optimizing the customer experience. They were using a different subscription software, Recharge Payments, but found it lacking in essential features that Two Dudes needed to scale.

Transitioning to Appstle for Subscriptions: A Strategic Move

White glove migration

Two Dudes turned to Appstle Subscriptions to solve their growing challenges and to meet their customer retention needs.

The implementation process involved migration from Recharge, which required meticulous handling, due to Two Dudes’ large and already existing loyal subscriber base. Appstle’s migrations team worked hands-on and closely with Two Dudes to ensure a smooth transition, despite the complexities of handling live data and ongoing deliveries.

Coveted features

1. Build a box

Two Dudes successfully integrated Appstle’s subscription software into its ongoing subscription model. One of the most coveted and advanced Appstle features that Two Dudes has leveraged extensively post-transition, is the Build-a-Box functionality for creating highly customizable bundles and subscription orders. The Build-a-Box feature has allowed Two Dudes the ability to upsell products and increase their average cart orders.

2. Customer portal access with magic link

Another game-changer for TwoDudes according to co-owner Tomas Tappin, has been the Magic Link feature that has allowed them to easily troubleshoot customers’ lost or forgotten password inquiries. TwoDudes finds the magic link feature to significantly reduce friction and efficiently help shoppers retrieve their accounts.

“Another game-changer for Two Dudes, has been the Magic Link feature that has allowed us to easily troubleshoot customers’ lost or forgotten password inquiries. Two Dudes finds the magic link feature to significantly reduce friction and efficiently help shoppers retrieve their accounts.” “So many times people come to us and say, I can’t get in, and assume our system is not working. And 99% of the time, it’s just a user error, and they have forgotten their user account passwords and don’t know how to use the forget password feature…With the magic link, instead of us having to go back and forth, change passwords, and try to do multiple activation emails, we can just ask them to ‘click here (on the magic link)’ . And then we know it’s gonna flow straight through! That’s been a real game changer.” Tomas Tappin
Co-founder of Two Dudes

3. Unlimited email notifications

Appstle’s email marketing automation features have also been helpful in establishing great customer rapport.

“So one thing that was super important for us when we decided to offer our products as a subscription, was to avoid scenarios where our customers forget they have a subscription and feel scammed when they get auto delivery and get auto-billed. It decreases the trust for the brand . But we’ve been using the automated email feature from Appstle, to send out notices to our customers in advance of a subscription delivery and rebill. It goes “Hey, your next box is getting ready to ship in three days, do you want it? Or “Is this stuff stockpiling under your bathroom? Do you need to pause?”
These auto notifications to customers not only ensures that our customers are well aware before a delivery and auto bill but also allows us an opportunity to inject some brand humor and tone of voice into the email. t has definitely helped us increase productivity as well because we can do the email notifications on autopilot with Appstle.” Tomas Tappin
Co-founder of Two Dudes

Transformative Results

The migration to Appstle Subscriptions from Recharge Payments, brought a seismic shift across Two Dudes’ operations and customer journey, yielding remarkable outcomes.

A few (among many!) key results were:

  • Elevated customer retention and all-round engagement through personalized subscription offerings.
  • Enhanced revenue streams via tiered discounts and effective upselling strategies enabled by Appstle Subscription’s Build-a-Box.
  • Streamlined internal processes and increased efficiency through Appstle’s profit maximization-driven features such as automated and unlimited email notifications, and Magic Links.
  • A reinforced competitive edge by making subscription services indispensable for Two Dudes’ customer base, in line with the growing trend in Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG) products.

Growth and Scale with Appstle

Two Dudes Co-founder Tomas Tappin highlighted Appstle’s tremendous value, superior features, and exceptional customer support, emphasizing the platform’s role in their sustained growth. Appstle’s Merchant Success team, a 24×7 support channel led by highly trained e-commerce engineers was commended for its responsiveness and proactive problem-solving approach, significantly contributing to Two Dudes’ positive experience.

Two Dudes’ journey with Appstle underscores the platform’s effectiveness and pervasiveness in addressing the unique challenges of scaling subscription-based businesses. Two Dudes’ ongoing expansion into new markets and channels reflects confidence in Appstle’s ability to support its exponential growth trajectory. Two Dudes unequivocally recommends Appstle to businesses seeking a comprehensive subscription management solution with unmatched value and support.

Two Dudes was rated by Sports Illustrated as the #1 men’s skincare brand from the southern hemisphere in 2024. You can learn more at www.twodudesproject.com

items.title: Pandoo: Sustaining Success Through Eco-friendly Subscriptions with Appstle

seo.title: Case Studies: Pandoo - Appstle
seo.description: Explore Pandoo's eco-friendly triumph with Appstle. Learn how a strategic subscription model, supported by Appstle, fueled international growth and sustainability.

items.html:
I. Introduction

About Pandoo

Salvatore Decker, a mechanical engineer with a passion for sustainable living, founded Pandoo in 2016 to offer eco-friendly alternatives to fast-moving consumer goods or FMCGs. Inspired by witnessing widespread deforestation during his travels, in Maylasia’s biggest rainforest – Taman Negara, Salvatore envisioned a brand that utilized bamboo as a sustainable material. After initially launching on Amazon FBA, Pandoo transitioned to WordPress and Woocommerce around 2016, subsequently switching to Shopify in early 2018, to diversify its product range and sales channels, aiming to reach a wider audience.

The Challenge

Pandoo faced a unique challenge in selling fast-moving and everyday consumer goods online, particularly products such as toilet paper and cotton buds that were traditionally purchased in physical brick-and-mortar stores. Salvatore recognized the need to target a specific customer group, focusing on individuals with limited time but a desire for environment-friendly alternatives and sustainable living. The solution was a reliable subscription model that aimed to turn households into sustainable ones!

II. Appstle Implementation

Why Appstle?

Appstle entered the scene as the chosen app or software tool to facilitate Pandoo’s subscription model and recurring deliveries of its sustainable products. Salvatore explains that the decision was based on Appstle’s native connection to Shopify and Shopify Plus, state-of-the-art and highly user-friendly features, and grass-roots credibility and positive reviews from thousands of ecommerce stores worldwide.

“Appstle looked the best for me just based on reviews and the Shopify App Store and then I tried it out and was happy from the first day as it worked exactly as I wanted it to. We implemented Appstle two years ago, and we should have done it earlier.”

The implementation of Appstle proved seamless, aligning with Pandoo’s vision to offer a subscription box service tailored to the needs of environment-conscious consumers – a growing niche.

Navigating Supply Chain Challenges

Despite the eagerness to implement subscriptions, Pandoo faced supply chain disruptions during the COVID-19 pandemic. High demand and supply chain delays hindered the initial plans. Salvatore recounts the challenges of ensuring stock availability, especially for high-demand products such as toilet paper. We all remember the toilet paper fiasco during the peak of COVID! Offering its products as a subscription, a model that brings with it a strong grip on inventory and delivery forecasting, helped Pandoo overcome supply chain and inventory obstacles.

“In the beginning, we were only able to offer a toilet paper subscription and I was able to set that up in a few hours with Appstle. I needed help with a small portion of the setup process and contacted Appstle support. I got help immediately and they not only fixed it but also guided me on the process, for future.
Now we’re utilizing the build-a-box feature which has worked beautifully and seamlessly!”

III. Results & Impact

International Scalability

The implementation of the subscription model, facilitated by Appstle, had dual benefits for Pandoo. Firstly, it greatly improved supply chain efficiency through better forecasting and planning. Secondly, the subscription model significantly enhanced customer retention and customer lifetime value (CLTV), with a focus on consumer products that require regular replenishment.

Pandoo achieved a stable supply chain and a reliable subscription service business model, allowing them to provide sustainable alternatives to a niche market.

IV. Testimonials

Salvatore emphasizes the importance of customer lifetime value for a brand such as Pandoo that operates in a niche but fast-growing space. The subscription model not only ensured regular AND AUTOMATIC product renewals but also created a steady channel for customer engagement. With Appstle’s support, Pandoo established itself as a reliable partner and source for environmentally conscious customers, providing convenient and sustainable alternatives to everyday products.

“I wholeheartedly recommend Appstle to Shopify Plus merchants. It is remarkably user-friendly and easy to implement, offering a multitude of features.”

V. Conclusion

Pandoo’s journey from a vision of sustainability to a successful and highly revered consumer brand with Shopify and Appstle Subscriptions showcases the adaptability and innovation necessary for businesses in the fast-moving consumer goods industry. Salvatore Decker’s commitment to eco-friendly alternatives, combined with strategic decisions like transitioning to Shopify and Appstle, has positioned Pandoo as a coveted and competitive player in the market.

As Pandoo continues to grow, the subscription model remains a key driver of success, highlighting the symbiotic relationship between sustainability, technology, and customer-centric strategies.

items.title: Empowering Vedix’s Global Ascent with Appstle Subscriptions

seo.title: Case Studies: Vedix - Appstle
seo.description: Dive into Appstle's Vedix Case Study. Discover how our solutions empowered Vedix to achieve e-commerce excellence and drive global business growth

items.html:
I. Introduction

Hailing from the innovation hub of IncNut, the creator behind celebrated brands such as StyleCraze and SkinKraft, Vēdix stands as a pioneer in presenting the world with its groundbreaking Customized Ayurvedic Haircare Solution. Nearly 12 years ago, IncNut originally began as a dual lifestyle media brand, gaining substantial recognition in fields such as pregnancy, beauty, and wellness.

Recognizing the potential to better serve its vast subscriber base, IncNut transitioned from offering blogs and expert knowledge to providing personalized products tailored to its customers’ evolving wellness needs. The result? Vēdix, a revolutionary Ayurvedic haircare solution was born. Vēdix first emerged in India, and then swiftly expanded its presence to over 12 international markets, including the US, Canada, UK, EU, Australia, and New Zealand.

The Challenge

As Vēdix prepared to venture into international markets, they confronted a significant challenge—the absence of built-in, automated solutions to offer subscriptions to their customers, a critical component of their unique business model. This led them to develop their own solution. However, the challenges of automatically billing their rapidly growing international customer base for their subscriptions soon became a pressing concern.

“When we launched our business in India first, Shopify didn’t support subscriptions business model. So we built our own subscription software but it was more like a pseudo subscription, because there wasn’t any auto-renewal happening, since a lot of orders were paid with cash. So, we could not automate subscriptions.
And just when we expanded internationally to the US, Europe and Australia, Shopify and Shopify Plus started adding subscription software. We found Appstle.”

II. Appstle Implementation

Why Appstle?

The pivotal turning point for Vēdix came when they discovered Appstle Subscriptions on the Shopify Plus platform.

Not only did Appstle seamlessly address their immediate need for automated subscriptions, but it also provided advanced API features that enabled Vēdix to send personalized email reminders to their subscribers via webhooks to their custom-built CMS system.

“Appstle was not just a perfect and native fit with Shopify, but also with our internal management, operations, and customer support systems. Once we had APIs and webhooks, we could also neatly integrate them with our internal CRM, across different countries in Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific.”

Smooth & Quick Implementation

In a candid conversation with Sasank Mukkamala, Vice President at IncNut (Vēdix), he commended the ease of the Appstle installation process. With just one click, Appstle Subscriptions are integrated seamlessly into their multiple international stores on Shopify Plus. Vēdix found Appstle appealing due to its ease of installation and its comprehensive subscription capabilities and functionalities. Appstle’s 24x7x365 support is a huge plus as well.

“When we installed Appstle on the first store, we were new to subscription software. Appstle’s customer service team is very very fast at responding compared to any other app I’ve used on Shopify. They are always there!”

III. Results & Impact

Global Scalability

By implementing Appstle Subscriptions across all 12 of their international stores, Vēdix rapidly expanded, allowing them to penetrate global markets with agility and effectively compete in the aggressive haircare industry.

Notably, when Vēdix embarked on its journey with Appstle Subscriptions in January 2022, webhook functionality was on the horizon. However, in response to Vēdix’s request, Appstle displayed remarkable speed and agility by introducing the feature within days. This pivotal enhancement empowered Vēdix to further integrate its internal systems with Appstle, streamlining their business operations and providing them with a more precise analysis of overall business performance.

IV. Testimonials

In an open conversation, Sasank highlighted the unparalleled commitment of Appstle’s customer support. Operating 24/7/365, their responsiveness and swift implementation stood out in comparison to other Shopify Apps. His recommendation was unequivocal:

“I wholeheartedly recommend Appstle to Shopify Plus merchants. It is remarkably user-friendly and easy to implement, offering a multitude of features.”

V. Conclusion

Vēdix’s journey with Appstle exemplifies adaptability and innovation, propelling them from facing subscription challenges to establishing comprehensive and streamlined international operations. As Vēdix continues to thrive in global markets, its collaboration with Appstle remains steadfast, with ambitions for future expansions and growth.

items.title: Kibbles Enhances Customer Retention and Increases Revenue with Appstle

seo.title: Case Studies: Kibbles - Appstle
seo.description: Dive into Appstle's case study for Kibbles SG. Discover how our innovative tech solutions tackled challenges and enhanced their digital operations efficiently.

items.html:
I. Introduction

Kibbles.sg is an online pet store based in Singapore that offers a full range of pet supplies and services, with a mission to become the Chewy of Southeast Asia. The company was founded by Andrew Lim, a former venture capitalist who wanted to pursue his passion for animals by starting his own business. While Lim had experience investing in startups, he had no prior experience in building websites or online businesses. In 2001, he decided to use Shopify as his e-commerce platform to start Kibbles, as it provided the infrastructure he needed to start selling almost immediately without spending months on development. Shopify’s ease of use allowed Lim to focus on building his business and delivering excellent customer service, which is critical in the highly competitive pet industry. In recent years, Kibbles has continued to grow and expand its offerings tremendously, thanks in part to the Shopify app solutions provided by Appstle, which has helped the company overcome some of the challenges it faced in managing marketing costs and retaining customers.

II. Appstle Implementation

Kibbles chose and implemented Appstle’s Subscriptions app and Memberships app to manage marketing costs, especially their Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV)and plan the subscrription orders ahead for inventory purchases. Appstle Subscriptions app allowed them to offer a monthly or twice-monthly (bi monthly) subscription program to their customers.

Appstle Memberships enabled them to offer their subscribers exclusive products, which added to the convenience and value of the core subscription program. The implementation process was seamless, and the Appstle team was responsive and hands on during the implementation process. Appstle also customized the subscriptions and memberships features for Kibbles to best suit their brand and customers.

III. Results

Kibbles experienced increased productivity and efficiency, improved customer engagement and experience, and higher revenue after implementing Appstle. Their data insights also became sharper, due to Appstle’s granular analytics.With Appstle’s Subscription App, Kibbles accurately forecasted demand, purchased ahead of time, and avoided overstocking, preventing waste. Additionally, the Subscription App allowed them to offer different discounts to customers depending on which brand and products they subscribed to, incentivizing subscription. Appstle’s Membership App helped to engage customers and create a sense of exclusivity, allowing auto-ship subscribers to access exclusive products on their website. This reinforced the value of their subscription and increased customer retention. Measurable results includes increased revenue and cost savings. Kibbles also improved their internal processes, scalability, and competitive advantage.

IV. Testimonials

The CEO of Kibbles.sg expressed appreciation for the exceptional product and customer service provided by the Appstle team. As someone who does not code, and whose core focus is on growing Kibbles, Appstle enabled him to do just that, instead of worrying about the operational tech tools. hey were impressed by the level of assistance received. The Appstle team was able to customize the platform to suit their requirements. Customers were also satisfied with the improved customer experience, personalized discounts, exclusive products, and the convenience that subscriptions and memberships provide!

V. Conclusion

Kibbles recommends Appstle’s Subscriptions App and Memberships App to other businesses in the pet industry. The benefits of using the Appstle platform outweigh any potential concerns about competitors using it as well. Kibbles will continue to use Appstle to enhance its online store’s offerings and improve its business processes.

VI. Additional Information

Screenshots and infographics illustrate the impact of Appstle on Kibbles operations. Appstle’s exceptional customer service, customization, and responsiveness make it a valuable platform for businesses in the pet industry. Resources and links for readers who want to learn more about Appstle or Kibbles are provided.

items.title: Otaku Box Streamlines Customer Service and Amplifies its Subscriptions with Appstle

seo.title: Case Studies: The Otaku Box - Appstle
seo.description: Explore Appstle's work with The Otaku Box in our case study. Learn how our tech solutions resolved hurdles and propelled their digital transformation journey.

items.html:
I. Introduction

The Otaku Box, established in 2017 by Liz Adkins, is a subscription service delivering a monthly package of anime-related products to its global clientele. Recognized as the premier subscription box for anime enthusiasts on Hulu, The Otaku Box specializes in catering to fans of Japanese anime, manga, and related culture, particularly those with limited access to anime merchandise in their local markets. The Otaku Box migrated to Appstle in February 2022.

Challenges Before Using Appstle

Before Appstle, The Otaku Box encountered various issues with its former platform, including customer experience, offering diverse upsells and downsells, retargeting, and subscription product management. The company had to rely on multiple third-party solutions to operate their business.

II. Appstle Integration

The Otaku Box discovered the answer to their subscription challenges with Appstle. This platform allowed them to transition from their smaller platform, gain valuable business insights, and utilize Shopify’s analytics. With Appstle, The Otaku Box could now offer direct subscription items and more upsells and downsells.

“We were wanting to use Shopify Plus because what we had before was so limiting in regards to data andcustomer experience. It limited our ability to offer different types of upsells and downsells, and retargeting.
However, we wanted a strong subscription software too. So once we found Appstle in the Shopify ecosystem, we were moved away from our older and smaller platform.
With Appstle we have way more insight into our business because it’s built on top of Shopify analytics.”

About Appstle

Appstle is a subscription, membership and loyalty management platform that as on Q2 2024 over 25,000 merchants, including The Otaku Box, in running their subscription business model through Shopify. The platform provides three core software products, ‘Appstle Subscriptions’ and ‘Appstle Memberships,’ and ‘Appstle Loyalty & Rewards’, with more in the pipeline. Appstle’s software are available on Shopify and Shopify Plus.

With over 3,000 5-star reviews on Shopify, Appstle holds the #1 position in the subscriptions category among 50+ apps on Shopify and ranks in the top 25 (of 7000+ apps on Shopify) across all categories. Appstle’s commitment to delivering exceptional apps at attractive prices enables merchants of all sizes and geographies to enjoy a successful e-commerce journey. Their powerful solutions address strategic pain points for their merchant partners, allowing them to efficiently and profitably retain customers, foster loyalty, and increase wallet share. Appstle offers tiered pricing to cater to the needs of businesses, from small enterprises to large corporations.

Integration Process and Timeline

Liz Adkins, founder of The Otaku Box, acknowledged that migrating platforms can be intimidating, especially when it involves transferring customer data and formatting it appropriately. However, she expressed satisfaction with the Appstle adoption, describing it as “probably the least painful” experience ever compared to earlier platform switches. Bojan, who managed operations at The Otaku Box, conceded that it was an enormous task, but Appstle successfully completed it in a short span of time.

One of The Otaku Box’s primary concerns was ensuring smooth billing processes to prevent any disruptions in customer experience. Appstle’s customer support, which they praised for being accessible 24/7 and providing immediate communication, helped them ensure the same.

Exceeding Customer Expectations

Appstle’s customer support played a vital role in The Otaku Box’s positive experience with the platform integration. The Otaku Box appreciated the continuous support, the team’s constant availability, and their personalized service. Moreover, Appstle’s extra efforts in ensuring successful billing were highly valued.

“With past platforms and software, anytime we had issues or anytime anything started to fall apart, we were just left there to figure it out on our own and that was a big worry for us.A big reason for our choosing Appstleis the support. Appstle made sure that we were succeeding, and didn’t just hand over a how-to guide and then say, off you go.”

III. Outcomes

The Appstle platform has improved The Otaku Box’s operations in several areas, including increased customer retention, enhanced customer engagement, increased revenue, improved customer experience, and advanced data insights.

1. Enhanced internal processes, scalability, and competitive edge

Before Appstle, The Otaku Box’s customer support was time-consuming and involved searching through multiple platforms for information. Now, they utilize the Appstle customer support, directly connected to Shopify, enabling customer support representatives to easily access order information and resolve issues swiftly. Consequently, the company has seen a significant improvement in response times, with about 90% of tickets completed within 24 hours and 50% resolved in under an hour. This has streamlined customer service and allowed the company to concentrate on other business aspects.

2. Expanded Subscription Offerings

The Appstle platform has enabled The Otaku Box to provide more subscription options to their customers, including tiered discounts for longer subscriptions. By offering a diverse range of subscription options, The Otaku Box can cater to various customer preferences and budgets, resulting in increased customer satisfaction and loyalty. Furthermore, offering discounts for longer subscriptions has encouraged customers to commit to long-term subscriptions, stabilizing The Otaku Box’s cash flow and increasing recurring revenue.

“We’re just able to offer so much more to the customer now than we were in the past to meet their needs. And that was the goal that we had from the beginning. Now we offer different types of subscriptions for customers’ specific needs. Before Appstle we weren’t able to do annual subscriptions for our customers. Now we can, in that has really helped our business. We are seeing a big bump in our revenue and customers.”

3. Advanced Data Insights

The Appstle platform has also simplified subscription management for The Otaku Box by providing real-time data and analytics on subscriber behavior. This has allowed the company to make informed decisions about pricing, product offerings, and marketing strategies.

The Appstle platform grants The Otaku Box access to more data and insights than ever before. With Appstle, they can identify popular products, understand customer interactions on their website, and determine factors influencing retention. This information enables the Otaku Box to make data-driven decisions and adjust their business strategy accordingly. They can also segment their customer base and tailor marketing efforts to specific groups, resulting in more effective campaigns and improved results.

Overall, the Appstle platform has been instrumental in helping The Otaku Box grow its business and thrive in the highly competitive subscription box industry.

4. Improved Internal Processes resulting in Scale

The Appstle platform has streamlined internal processes for The Otaku Box. They can now manage subscriptions and orders in one location, facilitating workflow and making inventory tracking and management easier. This has allowed them to scale their business more efficiently and reduce errors.

They no longer need to rely on multiple third-party solutions to run their business and can manage subscriptions and orders in one place. This has reduced complexity and allowed them to focus on growth.

5. Competitive Advantage

By using Appstle’s platform, The Otaku Box has gained a competitive edge in the market. They can offer more subscription options and upsells, streamline customer service, and make data-driven decisions. This has allowed them to provide a superior overall customer experience and stand out in a crowded market.

IV. Conclusion

In summary, the Appstle platform has been transformative for The Otaku Box. They overcame the challenges they faced with their previous platform and enhanced their operations across the board. Offering more subscription options, streamlining customer service, and gaining access to advanced data insights allowed them to scale their business efficiently and gain a competitive advantage in the market. The personalized customer support they received from Appstle was also crucial to their success. They plan to continue using the platform and are excited about the future prospects of their business.
